verification.oembed: NOT RUN. WebFetch fails DNS for every host in this session (youtube.com and even creativemotley.com), and Bash curl to youtube.com / web.archive.org is refused by the egress proxy (403, policy). Not routed around.

levels.indexed: The search index lists https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=<id> with this title, and its description or a news source ties it to the creator.
levels.channel-confirmed: A second source (news, podcast listing, channel mirror listing) names the uploading channel.
levels.channel-probable: The title format matches the channel's own uploads, but no source names the uploader.
levels.unverified: The id was found, but neither the uploader nor the content could be tied to the creator. Do not ship it until checked.

verification.how_to_verify: Where youtube.com is reachable: for id in $(node -e "const v=require('./docs/videos.json');console.log(v.creators.flatMap(c=>c.videos.map(x=>x.id)).join(' '))"); do curl -s "https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=$id&format=json" | node -e "let s='';process.stdin.on('data',d=>s+=d).on('end',()=>{try{const j=JSON.parse(s);console.log('$id',j.author_name,'|',j.title)}catch{console.log('$id','NOT FOUND')}})"; done  (check author_name against 'channel' below).
verification.thumbnails: i.ytimg.com is blocked here, so no thumbnail was fetched or checked. Card faces could use the site's own posters (public/assets/posters/<slug>.webp) until real thumbnails are fetched at build time somewhere unblocked.
